svg.title: L2 Services -- Kubernetes cluster
svg.desc: The API server is the hub. Every node's kubelet and kube-proxy talk to it, it stores state in etcd, and the scheduler and controller managers work through it. The cloud controller manager calls the cloud provider's API.
